headline: Resort real estate seeks momentum from recovery of tourism
summary: Vietnam's resort real estate market is showing signs of recovery, supported by growing tourism, infrastructure investment and an improving legal framework. Developers are urged to build products matched to demand.
why: Resort real estate depends on tourist arrivals and investment, so tourism trends and regulation shape developer returns in this segment.
